en: The bio-toxin is working its way through the alien fleet, causing agony and chaos in the enemy.
zh_new: 生物毒素正在泰倫蟲族艦隊中蔓延，讓敵人陷入痛苦與混亂。

en: These are likely Tyranid rippers, an early form of the alien invaders.
zh_new: 這些很可能是泰倫撕裂蟲，屬於異族入侵者的早期形態。

en: Once in position, the Armageddon will drop your hand-picked squads via drop pod toward the base of the massive capillary tower that is feeding the main hive ship.
zh_new: 就位後，阿米吉多頓號會用空投艙將你親自挑選的小隊投向那座巨大毛細塔的底部；它正在供養主蟲巢艦。

en: Once in position, the Armageddon will drop your hand-picked squads at the base of the massive capillary tower where the main hive ship is feeding.
zh_new: 就位後，阿米吉多頓號會將你親自挑選的小隊空投到那座巨大毛細塔的底部；主蟲巢艦正在那裡進食。

en: A hundred times over, Sergeant. The shockwave would also annihilate any ships in the system. Including the Armageddon.
zh_new: 足以摧毀上百次，軍士。衝擊波還會殲滅星系內的一切艦船，包括阿米吉多頓號。

en: Only a few hive ships need to escape a battle for the hive fleet to survive. These few ships will go on to devour a few poorly defended worlds.
zh_new: 只要有少數幾艘蟲巢艦逃離戰場，蟲巢艦隊便能存續。這幾艘船將繼續吞噬防禦薄弱的世界。
